subject: Post-demo: transfer eligibility, SOC 2 evidence & vendor questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@medico-eu.de>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@edgepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Post-demo: transfer eligibility, SOC 2 evidence & vendor questionnaire kickoff

Hi Anna and Tom,

Thanks again for joining the demo this morning — great conversation and helpful questions from the Medico team. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the compliance and region items so your legal/procurement team has a single thread to reference. High-level asks I captured: 

1) SOC 2 status and evidence: you asked for our current SOC 2 Type II scope and where to review a summary report. I attached a one-pager (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf) and a link to the detailed summary in Drive. We can provide the SOC 2 report under an NDA/controlled sharing flow if needed.

2) EU region availability and residency: you flagged a requirement to ensure patient data is stored in the EU and that cross-border transfers are minimized. We currently offer hosted deployments in both Amsterdam (eu-west-1 equivalent) and Frankfurt (eu-central-1 equivalent). We also have Dedicated/Private options if you need strict network isolation or on-prem.

3) Export controls / sanctions (OFAC/ITAR): you asked whether we perform sanctions screening and whether we can host ITAR-controlled data. Short answers: OFAC screening is part of our onboarding checks for accounts and can be applied to access lists; ITAR-hosting requires additional contractual and environment restrictions — we should surface specifics from legal.

4) Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): please send your questionnaire file or a OneTrust link and we'll kickoff. To accelerate things I copied Ben (security lead for Customer Success) who will own the VSQ coordination and provide technical answers.

Proposed next steps:
- Medico to share the vendor questionnaire (OneTrust/Excel) and procurement contact (if different from Tom).
- Redwood to provide SOC 2 summary + proposed DPA template and confirm EU region latency targets.
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up with procurement + security to triage ITAR/OFAC acceptability.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, sample_vsq_kickstart.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up once Ben has completed the initial pass on any questionnaire you send.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the clear summary. I attached our initial vendor questionnaire (edgepay_vsq_initial.xlsx) — it covers data processing, encryption, personnel access, and a short section on export controls. Procurement asked me to confirm the following quickly: 

- Do you have a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) template that includes standard SCCs?
- Can you confirm by region where logs and backups are stored (application logs vs. backups)?
- We have a HIPAA-related PII subset for some integrations; is Redwood willing to sign a BAA for that scope, or would we need a Private deployment?

Procurement is reachable at procurement@edgepay.com (they own the RFx). I’ll schedule a 30-min triage call once your security team has had a look.

Anna Müller
Head of Security & Privacy (contractor for Medico EU)
anna.mueller@medico-eu.de
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@medico-eu.de>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:34:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: transfer eligibility, SOC 2 evidence & vendor questionnaire kickoff

Hi Anna — thanks for the questionnaire. Quick answers to the bullets above and a few clarifications from the operations/security side: 

- DPA/SCCs: We have a standard DPA that includes the EU SCCs and the option to add additional safeguards. I can share the draft DPA and mark items typically added for healthcare customers.

- Logs vs backups: Application access logs (API calls, auth events) are retained in the same EU region as the customer tenant by default for hosted EU deployments. Backups are retained in the EU for hosted EU regions; we offer explicit cross-region backup only if requested by the customer and documented in the contract.

- HIPAA / BAA: For regulated PHI, our standard hosted plan is often sufficient with contractual protections, but many healthcare customers opt for Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private for added isolation and contractual terms (including BAA). We can discuss a scoped BAA for hosted if Medico’s legal team prefers that route; otherwise Dedicated/Private is the recommended path.

- OFAC / sanctions screening: We perform sanctions screening during onboarding for identified principals. If you have lists of restricted parties or specific countries of concern, share those and we’ll confirm compatibility.

- ITAR: ITAR-controlled materials are a special case. Our hosted public offering is not configured for ITAR out of the box; handling ITAR would require Private deployment with contractual and operational controls.

Next steps I propose from our side:
1) Redwood to post the SOC 2 summary link and a redacted copy of the Type II report under an NDA — I’ll coordinate with our compliance team.
2) Ben to complete VSQ answers in the provided spreadsheet within 48 business hours and share a marked-up copy.
3) Schedule a triage call (30 mins) with Medico procurement/legal and Redwood security — Olga, can you propose 2x slots tomorrow or Friday?

Links: SOC2 summary: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2-summary
Questionnaire kick-off via OneTrust: https://onetrust.example.com/rfq/edgepay-2027

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
